extDescription.message: Manage your physical card stock from your Moxfield collection: marking a deck as built takes its cards out of the stock.

stockHint.message: “Free” = available outside built decks. Click a card that is in decks to see which ones.

historyHint.message: Actions on the stock and built decks, most recent first.

collectionHint.message: Fetched from your Moxfield account (you just need to be signed in to it in this browser), even with Moxfield closed. It is the reference for the stock: to fix a quantity, edit your collection on Moxfield.

collectionAuto.message: Fetch automatically (after each change on Moxfield, and every hour)

csvHint.message: Fallback if the automatic fetch fails. On Moxfield: collection → Export → CSV. Importing again updates the stock without losing built decks.

syncOffHint.message: Automatic backup to a private folder in your Drive, synced between your computers. Only needed once per computer. If the popup closes during Google authorization, open it again.

syncAccountKeepLocal.message: Send this computer's stock to the new account

syncAccountChangedHint.message: The replaced version stays in the history. Switching back to the old account resumes the sync.

errorReportsHint.message: When the extension hits an error, an anonymous report is sent to the developer so it can be fixed: error message, extension version, browser and system. Never your stock, your decks or your email address.

dangerHint.message: Completely empties the stock and unbuilds every deck marked as physically built.

deckPageChanged.message: The list changed on Moxfield since the deck was built: $1 — seen on $2. Open the deck to update the build.

stockEmpty.message: No cards in stock — import your collection above.

stockMoreRows_one.message: … and $1 more card: narrow it down with the filter.

stockMoreRows_other.message: … and $1 more cards: narrow it down with the filter.

collectionUncovered_one.message: Your collection no longer covers $1 card from built decks:

collectionUncovered_other.message: Your collection no longer covers $1 cards from built decks:

syncChoiceNotice.message: Drive already holds data (changed on $1) and this computer has a stock too. Which one should be kept? The other version will stay in the history.

syncSwitchAccountWeb.message: To switch accounts: Disconnect, then Connect Google Drive with the other account.

syncSwitchAccountProfile.message: To switch accounts, change the Chrome profile's account: the extension will ask you what to do.

snapshotConflict.message: version set aside during a conflict

snapshotsNone.message: No versions in the history yet.

snapshotRestoreConfirm.message: Replace the stock and built decks with the version from $1? It will also be applied to your other computers.

syncAccountKeepRemoteConfirm.message: Replace this computer's stock with the new account's? (if it has none, this computer's stock will be sent to it)

syncDisconnectConfirm.message: Stop syncing on this computer? The data stays on this computer and on Drive.

resetSyncWarning.message: Sync is on: your other computers will be emptied too.

resetConfirm.message: Reset the whole stock and all built decks?

errorReportsNotConfigured.message: No report service is set up in this version: nothing is sent.

historyDeckBuilt_one.message: Deck “$2” built: $1 card taken out of the free stock

historyDeckBuilt_other.message: Deck “$2” built: $1 cards taken out of the free stock

historyDeckUnbuilt_one.message: Deck “$2” unbuilt: $1 card returned to the stock

historyDeckUnbuilt_other.message: Deck “$2” unbuilt: $1 cards returned to the stock

availabilityCount.message: $1/$2 cards available in the free stock, excluding basic lands

moxfieldSessionExpired.message: Moxfield session expired: sign in again on moxfield.com in this browser.

moxfieldBlocked.message: Moxfield refused the fetch (code $1). Try again later, or use the CSV import.

moxfieldUnexpected.message: Unexpected response from Moxfield (step “$1”, $2): the way it works may have changed. Use the CSV import in the meantime.

moxfieldNoSession.message: No Moxfield session: sign in on moxfield.com in this browser.

googleAccountReadError.message: Google Drive answered $1 when reading the account.

googleWindowFailed.message: The Google sign-in window could not complete.

googleBraveHint.message: In Brave, turn on “Allow Google login for extensions” (brave://settings/extensions), then try again.

csvColumnsMissing.message: 'Count' / 'Name' columns not found in the CSV — unexpected format.

deckNoLongerBuilt.message: This deck is no longer marked as built.

backupNotOurs.message: This file is not a Moxfield Stock Manager backup.

backupMissingParts.message: Corrupted backup: stock or built decks missing.

extensionReloaded.message: The extension was reloaded in the meantime — refresh this page (F5) and try again.

printingWarningTitle_one.message: In your collection but not in the right printing for this deck ($1 card)

printingWarningTitle_other.message: In your collection but not in the right printing for this deck ($1 cards)

printingWarningHint.message: build blocked, fix or remove these lines before confirming:

cardmarketCopyButton.message: Copy the missing cards for Cardmarket

clipboardCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the list to the clipboard.

cardmarketCopied_one.message: $1 card copied — on Cardmarket, open a wants list, add a deck list and paste.

cardmarketCopied_other.message: $1 cards copied — on Cardmarket, open a wants list, add a deck list and paste.

cardCountMismatch.message: $1 — ⚠️ the site shows $2: check the list before confirming

pageNoCards.message: no cards detected on the page.

pageTotalNotFound.message: $1, but the total shown by Moxfield (“N main deck”) was not found.

deckCannotCheck.message: Could not check whether the list changed since the deck was built: $1

deckSuspectSummary_one.message: See what was detected ($1 difference from the build)

deckSuspectSummary_other.message: See what was detected ($1 differences from the build)

deckUnchanged.message: The list hasn't changed since the deck was built ($1).

deckChangedTitle.message: The list changed on Moxfield since the deck was built ($1):

deckUpdateHint.message: “$1” adjusts the stock for these cards only.

deckUpdateBlocked.message: Not enough stock or different printing: fix it first (see above).

overlayTitleBuild.message: Mark this deck as physically built

overlayBuiltIntro.message: This deck is currently marked as built. Unbuilding it returns the cards it uses to the stock.

overlayIntro.message: List detected automatically from the page — check/fix it before confirming (one card per line, "QTY Name"). If it is empty or incomplete, click Moxfield's “Copy” button, then “$1”.

buttonBuiltOutdated.message: Physically built — the list changed since the deck was built (click to update)

clipboardEmpty.message: Clipboard empty or format not recognized — paste manually with Ctrl+V.

updateBlocked.message: Can't update — not enough stock or different printing.

updateDone.message: Build updated, stock adjusted for the changed cards.

noCardsRecognized.message: No cards recognized in the list — check the format (QTY Name).

buildBlockedWrongEdition.message: Can't build — different printing from your collection for: $1

unbuildDone.message: Deck unbuilt, cards returned to the stock.

buildDone.message: Deck marked as built, cards taken out of the stock.
